children: The MSPO trade fair is held annually in Kielce, Poland, and ranks among the most important events in the field of defence and security technology development and production. Companies belonging to the CSG group have also been exhibiting at MSPO for many years. During this year’s 34th edition, which will take place from 8 to 11 September, these will specifically include Tatra Export, Excalibur Army, Tatra Defence, MSM Group, Vývoj Martin, AviaNera Technologies, as well as CSG Polska and Polish company Domar MS. The companies will present their products in Hall 4 at stand E20 and also in outdoor exhibition areas 2Z-07 and 6Z-07.
Tatra Export

, a subsidiary of truck manufacturer Tatra Trucks, which it will represent in Poland, will present the third-generation of the Tatra Force model line in military version with an 8×8 chassis configuration in its Polish premiere in the outdoor exhibition area. The vehicle will be shown as a flatbed truck with an entirely new extended four-door cabin for a crew of up to six. This heavy tactical and logistics vehicle is equipped with an upgraded electronically controlled air-cooled twelve-cylinder Tatra T3D-930 engine with an output of 450 kW and an Allison automatic transmission. The new four-door cabin, developed for military purposes, features a number of safety elements as well as a modern interior including a digitalised dashboard. The vehicle’s maximum gross weight can be up to 44 tonnes, while it is capable of carrying a payload of up to 25.5 tonnes.
Tatra Defence (TD)

specialises in the development and production of armoured land vehicles, such as the Pandur 8×8 and TITUS 6×6. TD will bring the new Tadeas 4×4 vehicle based on a Tatra chassis to Kielce for the first time. The vehicle is suitable for a wide range of tasks and applications. The Tadeas in its 6×6 configuration has already been presented in Poland in the past. In addition, together with the local company Huta Stalowa Wola, TD has prepared the Polish-adapted MTV 6×6 Heron version, which will be manufactured in Poland for the Polish Armed Forces. The new Tadeas 4×4 therefore also has considerable potential to attract attention in Poland.
Excalibur Army

will present the Patriot 4×4 armoured vehicle equipped with the Alakran mortar system at the trade fair for the first time. The system features automatic aiming and an advanced fire-control system. This mobile mortar system is available in 81 mm or 120 mm calibre. The Patriot 4×4 is a proven design based on a Tatra chassis, which Excalibur Army has already delivered to a number of customers. The company has also recently succeeded in Southeast Asia, where it secured contracts for the delivery of more than 100 Patriot 4×4 armoured vehicles in various versions, including the mortar-equipped version that will be presented in Kielce.
Another exhibitor at the joint CSG group stand will be
MSM Group

, which comprises several manufacturers of modern medium- and large-calibre ammunition. ZVS is a traditional Slovak company that has specialised in artillery ammunition for decades. It will bring a selection of NATO-standard 155 mm artillery ammunition to Kielce. Another Slovak company, VOP Nováky, will present a full range of training artillery ammunition and mortar ammunition in 60 mm, 81 mm and 120 mm calibres at MSPO. MSM Group also includes the Spanish company Fábrica de Municiones Granada. It will present visitors in Kielce with various types of 120 mm tank ammunition and 105 mm artillery and tank ammunition, which is standard for modern NATO main battle tanks and artillery systems. MSM Group also includes ZVI Vsetín, which will exhibit 30×173 mm, 30×113 mm and 20×102 mm medium-calibre ammunition in Kielce, intended, for example, for infantry fighting vehicles, remotely operated weapon stations and aircraft cannons.
Vývoj Martin

will present two types of mobile containerised workstations at MSPO 2026, designed to support command, communications and operational control in the field. The first will be the Support Shelter SuS, a mobile workstation intended for command, planning and operational control. It provides a protected space for critical information and communication systems and enables continuity of command to be maintained even under demanding deployment conditions. The second solution on display will be the Technical High Mobility Operator Shelter (THMS OP), a highly mobile operator shelter designed for communications, coordination and support tasks in the field. It enables a workstation for operating technical systems and ensuring communications to be established quickly directly in the area of operations.
AviaNera Technologies

will also exhibit at the CSG group stand. The company specialises in the development, production and sale of small jet engines intended for unmanned systems. In Kielce, it will present the compact MTJ300-series jet engine, which is designed for light UAVs, guided missiles and training targets. Its main advantages include compact dimensions and very low operating weight.
CSG Polska
and Polish company
Domar MS

, the member of CSG group, will also present themselves at MSPO in a separate exhibition area. CSG Polska is responsible for CSG Group’s business activities on the Polish market and specialises in the distribution of products in the defence and security, automotive, aerospace and railway sectors.

The importance of MSPO in Kielce, not only for Europe, is illustrated not only by the prestigious names among its exhibitors but also by specific figures. This year, the exhibition area will expand to more than 40,000 m², with a record number of more than 1,000 exhibitors from 40 countries taking part. By comparison, the 32nd edition was attended by 769 exhibitors from 34 countries around the world. CSG group companies consider MSPO one of the most important trade fairs of its kind in Europe alongside Eurosatory in Paris. This is demonstrated, for example, by the fact that some of their products have made their European premieres there in the past, as well as by the awards CSG group received for the best stand design among all exhibitors in 2021 and 2023.)
